lightning.configuration.title: Lightning
lightning.configuration.recording.toolti: What /lightning profiler start records when no options are given.
lightning.configuration.gpu.tooltip: SECTIONS times each render step, FRAME only the whole frame, OFF none.
lightning.configuration.gpuEveryNthFrame: 1 = every frame (most detail). Higher = less cost on the render thread; results are scaled to per-frame.
lightning.configuration.javaSampling.too: Shows which mods' code is using the CPU.
lightning.configuration.memoryTracking.t: Shows what is allocating memory. Needs Java code sampling.
lightning.configuration.worldTiming.tool: Times every mob, machine and block entity, by chunk.
lightning.configuration.sampleIntervalMs: How often Java code is sampled. Lower = more detail, more cost.
lightning.configuration.heapSnapshotAtEn: Shows what is filling memory, by mod. Pauses the game briefly when the capture ends.
lightning.configuration.automation.toolt: Start a capture by itself, for benchmarks.
lightning.configuration.autoStart.toolti: Starts a capture after joining a world (or when a dedicated server starts).
lightning.configuration.autoStartDelaySe: Gives the world time to load before recording.
lightning.configuration.autoDurationSeco: How long the automatic capture runs.
lightning.configuration.quitWhenDone.too: Closes the game after the automatic capture is saved.
lightning.configuration.captureParts.too: Record only these parts in automatic captures, e.g. gpu,render,cpu. Empty records everything.
lightning.configuration.windowSeconds.to: Splits every capture into phases of this many seconds, to compare parts of a run. 0 = off.
lightning.configuration.captureWorldJoin: Records every world join, from the click until the world shows, to find what makes joining slow.
lightning.configuration.startup.tooltip: Work done while the game loads.
lightning.configuration.prepareAtLoad.to: Prepares Java sampling during loading so starting a capture later doesn't lag.
